learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be handled separately from security verdicts - a failed review should not produce an 'inconclusive' security verdict when the file is clearly benign
The audit tool should distinguish between 'couldn't review due to error' and 'reviewed and found uncertain' in its verdict logic
Implement retry logic for transient API errors before marking a file as inconclusive
When multiple models review the same package, a tool error in one model should not override successful reviews from other models for clearly non-executable files like .gitattributes or .gitignore
